map.输入规划总用地面积与人口规模，计算人口密度、人均用地及可容纳人口容量，并对照规划: Enter the total planned land area and population to compute population density, per-capita land and the capacity population, then check them against planning standards, for area carrying assessment and land use intensity control.
map.核算人口密度：人口毛密度 = 总人口 ÷ 总用地，人口净密度 = 总人口 ÷ 居: Assess population density: gross population density = total population / total land, net population density = total population / residential land, used to evaluate livability in a planning area.
map.计算人均用地 = 总用地×10000 ÷ 人口，对照规范人均标准（新建城市 85: Compute per-capita land = total land x 10000 / population and compare it with the code standard (85-105 m2/person for a new city, etc.) to judge whether it exceeds the limit.
map.测算人口容量：取\"按人均用地\"与\"按净密度\"两者较小值，得到适宜承载人口: Estimate population capacity: take the smaller of the capacity by per-capita land and by net density to get the appropriate carrying population.
map.人口毛密度和净密度有什么区别？: What's the Difference Between Gross and Net Population Density?
map.毛密度用总用地（含道路、公服、工业等）作分母，数值较小；净密度只用居住用地作分母: Gross density uses total land (including roads, public services and industry) as the denominator, so the value is smaller; net density uses only residential land, giving a larger value closer to actual residential crowding. Only the two together give a full picture.
map.人均建设用地标准如何取？: How Do I Take the Per-Capita Construction Land Standard?
map.按规划区类型：新建城市 85–105 m²/人、旧城改造 75–95、建制镇 8: By planning area type: new city 85-105 m2/person, old-city redevelopment 75-95, established town 80-100, village 90-120. Below the lower limit means density is too high; above the upper limit means the land is used too loosely.
